jobs.description: Amazon Customer Service supports customers around the world through one of the world’s largest and most diverse customer service workforces. As AI fundamentally changes how customer service work is performed, it also creates an opportunity to reinvent how associates learn, develop their capabilities, receive coaching, and continuously improve. The Associate Development team is building the next generation of learning, coaching and performance experiences for Amazon Customer Service Associates. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build these systems from the ground up. This is a highly greenfield opportunity. Rather than digitizing traditional training and coaching processes, we are rethinking how associate development should work in an AI-native world. What does an associate need to learn before doing a job? What can they learn through experience? What should AI provide in the flow of work? How can we understand an associate’s evolving capabilities and use that understanding to personalize development? How can generative AI help provide timely, relevant and effective coaching at the scale of a global workforce? Imagine systems that continuously learn from an associate’s experience and outcomes, identify where they would benefit from development, and deliver personalized learning or AI-powered coaching. The outcomes of those interventions can then become new evidence about the associate, creating a closed loop that gets smarter over time. As an SDE on this team, you will help define and build the technical foundations that make this possible. You will work on problems spanning generative AI, personalization, intelligent recommendations, learning and coaching systems, experimentation, data and distributed systems. You will have the opportunity to influence architecture at an early stage rather than inherit a predetermined technical solution. You will partner closely with Product, Science, UX and engineering teams across Amazon to turn ambiguous customer problems into scalable technical solutions. The systems you build have the potential to shape how Customer Service Associates around the world develop and succeed at work. This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys zero-to-one problems, emerging AI technologies, large-scale systems and building products with direct human impact. Key job responsibilities - Design and build scalable services and experiences that power personalized learning, coaching and associate development across Amazon Customer Service. - Build AI-powered coaching capabilities, including applications of generative AI that can understand context, generate relevant guidance and adapt experiences to individual associate needs. - Develop systems that connect signals about associate capability and performance with the right development intervention at the right time. - Help create closed-loop systems that measure the outcomes of learning and coaching interventions and use that evidence to continuously improve future recommendations. - Work with Product and Science partners to translate emerging models and experimentation into reliable production systems. - Make foundational architectural decisions for a greenfield product space while determining where existing Amazon capabilities can be reused or evolved. - Design APIs, data models and integration patterns that allow Associate Development capabilities to interact with associate context, workflow and other Customer Service systems. - Build mechanisms for experimentation, measurement and observability so we can understand whether the experiences we create actually improve associate and customer outcomes. - Deliver secure, reliable and globally scalable systems while maintaining a high bar for operational excellence. - Mentor other engineers and establish engineering standards and technical direction as the team grows. A day in the life You might start the day working with a scientist on how an AI coaching experience can use an associate’s recent performance context to generate more useful coaching. Later, you could whiteboard an architecture for measuring whether that coaching actually changed future performance, review an API contract with another CS platform team, and prototype a new generative-AI capability. Because the space is early, you won’t simply be executing against a fully specified roadmap. You will help answer fundamental technical questions, prototype alternatives, make architecture decisions, and turn successful experiments into production systems capable of serving associates globally. About the team The Associate Experience (AE) team is building the future of work for Amazon Customer Service Associates. Our vision is to create a trusted Customer Service experience by enabling associates to succeed as the role evolves toward complex and non-deterministic problem solving. Within AE, the Associate Development team is reinventing how associates learn, develop and improve, moving beyond one-size-fits-all training and coaching towards, personalized development powered by AI. Engineers joining the team will shape foundational architecture, drive technology choices, and build AI-powered products from the ground up for one of the world's largest customer service workforces.

jobs.description: Job Description: SUMMARY Move finish goods and raw materia l s from and to the production lines safely . The shift is Monday - Friday from 3 PM- 11 PM. JOB DUTIES Assists the Team Lead on production line by moving finished good products from the production Line to the shipping area, and moving raw materials to the production line efficiently while maintaining Environmental, Health, Safety, Quality, and Production standards. Promotes and follows all EHS and Quality guidelines and procedures. Performs minor set-ups, cleaning, and general operation of the mobile equipment used. Report production on every pallet. Recommend safety improvements as needed Ensures all housekeeping and equipment standards are met. Assists in training temporary workers to pick/place/pack/palletize. S upport Warehouse Lead on receiving materials. Support Planning area on stock counts and moving materials. Other Duties as assigned. QUALIFICATIONS High School Diploma/GED required . 3 -5 years’ experience working in a manufacturing environment; preferably automotive or bottling and packaging. Must be able to speak, understand, read, and write English. Must have the ability to perform simple math calculations. Must be computer literate. Must be certified to drive all types of forklifts. PHYSICAL DEMANDS While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to stand; walk; climb; balance on moving vehicles in standing and sitting positions, operate mechanical moving equipment; and to hear. The employee is constantly exposed to vibration while operating mechanical equipment . The employee is frequently required to bend; stoop; stand; handle; finger; feel; reach forward with arms; and talk . The employee is occasionally required to sit; crouch; kneel; squat; and twist . The employee is rarely required to crawl . The employee must occasionally lift, push/pull, and or move up to 65 pounds . The employee must possess the mandatory ability to react and move quickly in case of emergency . Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus/accommodate. RISKS While performing the duties of this job, the employee is exposed to the possibility of injury to the hands or feet and collision with moving equipment . The possibility of fire exists. On rare occasion , the employee has the possibility of exposure (once a day) to electrical shock and battery explosion. The employee may also rarely come into contact with toxic / caustic chemicals from damaged product . WORK ENVIRONMENT While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts and machinery . A strong citrus odor is present constantly in the work environment . The noise level in the work environment is moderate . Work is performed inside with moderate amounts of heat, cold and humidity encountered . Inside work can be dirty, with adequate lighting and ventilation . Conditions can include the presence of hazards such as flammable liquids, moving machinery and working around and with others. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. This job description should not be construed to contain every function/responsibility that may be required to be performed by an incumbent in this position . Incumbents are required to perform other related functions as assigned. Compensation Information: The hourly rate is between $20 - $23, depending on experience. ITW is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?
At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.
Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
ENGINEERING - UNREAL ENGINE
What We Do
Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.
What You'll Do
The Content Delivery team builds the critical technologies that deliver high-quality content on demand to live Fortnite players. You'll develop core features for the next generation of Unreal Engine, working across game teams and Epic projects to shape how dynamic content is delivered at scale.
In this role, you will
Architect and implement low-level engine systems across multiple platforms, including networking, I/O access interfaces, analytics, and the language toolchain, with a focus on robustness, performance, and usability
Re-architect Unreal Engine to support the long-term vision of delivering content on demand at a more granular level
Own the design, development, and delivery of complex new features in a live game product
Bring together multiple engine subsystems to achieve maintainable functional solutions
Design stable, forward-thinking APIs that expose engine capabilities to gameplay layers, for both internal and external developers
Collaborate across core engine and gameplay teams to build solutions that meet diverse and evolving needs
Drive technical excellence across platforms, including debugging, maintenance, system reliability, and optimization
What we're looking for
Strong C++ skills with the ability to architect low-level game systems and associated tooling
Experience creating and maintaining APIs with strong backward compatibility requirements
Demonstrated ability to apply code design patterns in live environments to reduce maintenance and improve stability
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to find solutions beyond established approaches
Ability to navigate ambiguity and collaborate with teams to define deliverables
Experience with multiple programming languages and a track record of leveraging their strengths effectively
Excellent communication skills
Experience writing performant code across multiple hardware platforms, including game consoles
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows is a plus
EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE
Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Our coverage includes Medical, Dental, a Vision HRA, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance & a 401k with competitive match. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents. Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.
ABOUT US
Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.
Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

jobs.description: Job Title: Workplace and Community Coordinator (Part-Time; Temporary) | Redmond, WA Requisition ID: R028026 Job Description: Job Title: Workplace and Community Coordinator (Part-Time; Temporary) Reporting To: Director, Operations Department: CT Operations Location: Redmond, WA Schedule: Approximately 15–25 hours per week Duration : 12 months Your Mission We are looking for a Workplace & Community Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations and employee experience of our Redmond office. Opportunity to shape the employee experience of a growing office. Exposure to one of the world's leading gaming and entertainment companies. Collaborative, creative, and supportive work environment. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization. We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up. Ready to Activate Your Future? 회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

쿠팡 Global Security Operations Center(이하 GSOC)는 위기관리센터로서 내외부 위험에 대한 실시간 모니터링을 제공하고 사건/사고 발생시 위기관리 프로세스에 따라 신속한 대응을 주도하여 직원의 안전을 보장하고 비즈니스 운영의 연속성을 지원합니다. 회사에서 일어날 수 있는 다양한 사건, 사고에 대처하기 위해 24시간 365일 운영되며 사건/사고 발생시 해당 사건, 사고를 빠른 시간내에 전파하고 이를 해결할 수 있는 적절한 지원이 이뤄지도록 합니다.

업무 내용

• Global Security 부서의 커뮤니케이션 허브 역할
• 모니터링 시스템을 통해 인지된 다양한 리스크 및 사건사고 접수 및 적시 대응
• 글로벌 이벤트 모니터링 및 영향 평가 후 GSOC의 파트너들에게 공유
• 회사 운영, 임직원, 시설 및 고객에게 영향을 미칠 수 있는 외부 위협에 대한 인지, 위험성 평가 및 분류
• 공급망 자산과 관련된 위험 모니터링 후 전달
• GSOC Supervisor(Manager) 업무 지원

고용형태

• 정규직
• 주/야 및 주말 스케줄 근무 진행

자격 요건

• 비상관리, 안전관리, 환경, 경영, 경제, 커뮤니케이션, 정보기술, 정치 과학, 공학, 지리학, 경비학 등의 전공의 학사학위를 보유하신 분
• 우수한 커뮤니케이션 기술을 통해 서면(필요시 구두)으로 경영진 수준과 의사소통 할 수 있는 능력이 있으신 분
• 높은 스트레스 및 시간제약이 있는 상황에서 멀티태스킹이 가능하신 분
• 모호한 상황에서도 비판적으로 분석하고 사고하시는 분
• 스스로 동기를 부여하고 대응력이 뛰어나며, 적극적이며 끝까지 작업을 주도하실 수 있는 분
• 주/야 및 주말 스케줄 근무 가능하신 분
• 중급 이상의 영어 회화가 가능하신 분

우대 사항

• 산업안전/EHS/물리 보안/군사/SOC(Security Operations Center)/관제/리스크관리/고객대응 등 관련 업계에 3년 이상 근무 경험을 가지신 분
• 글로벌 이벤트와 글로벌 지리/문화에 대한 실무지식이 있으신 분
• 컴퓨터 지식과 기술, 복잡한 플랫폼 작업을 경험하신 분
• IT, 정보, 기업, 군사 또는 보안 경험이 있으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형절차

•

서류전형 – 직무 적합성 인터뷰 – 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격

• 전형절차는 직무 별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동 될 수 있습니다.
• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고사항

• 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.

• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.

The Direct to Consumer (D2C) Data Science organization comprises Data Science, Data Engineering and ML Engineering practices. Role overview

Within D2C Data Science, the D2C ML Engineering team is seeking an AI Software Engineer to help design, build, and support production AI capabilities that solve high-value business problems across SPOC and the broader digital commerce ecosystem. This is not a model-training or predictive-platform ownership role; it is an applied AI engineering role focused on turning AI into dependable products, services, and automation.

You will work with core engineering, operations, data, risk, and product partners to build AI-powered workflows that improve speed, quality, insight, and decision support. The work may include LLM-powered services, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, tool/function calling, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and reusable AI platform components.

Production AI Engineering: Develop scalable APIs, microservices, and event-driven workflows in Python or Java, with attention to reliability, resilience, security, cost efficiency, and clean integration with existing services.

Cloud Delivery and Automation: Deploy AI services using AWS, containers, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, observability, and operational runbooks.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Participate in design reviews, implementation planning, troubleshooting, documentation, and knowledge sharing across technical and non-technical teams.

Coding Proficiency: Strong software engineering skills in Python and/or Java, including API development, testing, debugging, asynchronous processing, and maintainable service design.

Cloud Competency: Experience with AWS or equivalent cloud services

About the Team

At OpenAI, Trust & Safety Operations is central to protecting OpenAI’s platform, customers, and the public from abuse. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Policy and Go To Market teams to identify emerging risks, build and mature enforcement systems, and ensure high-integrity operations while delivering a great user experience at scale.

We’re building the Monetization Trust & Safety Operations team to ensure OpenAI can grow advertising in a way that is safe, trusted, and sustainable—for users, advertisers, and the business. This team sits at the intersection of operational scale, product risk, and rapid revenue growth, designing systems and operations that enable ads to scale without compromising user trust or safety. It’s critical to us that our Ads product be built in a way that corresponds to our Ads principles https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fopenai%2Ecom%2Findex%2Four-approach-to-advertising-and-expanding-access%2F&urlhash=tnG4&isSdui=true, and this team is key to that.

About the Role

We’re looking for a senior operator with strong analytical instincts to help build and scale Monetization Trust & Safety Operations at OpenAI. In this role, you’ll flex across the team’s highest-priority data and operational needs—from reporting and dashboard insights to budget and capacity planning, project-based analysis, and data automation —while partnering closely with Product, Policy, Engineering, Legal, Go To Market, and Data Science and Data Engineering teams.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and data: you’ll define ambiguous problems, query and validate data, build decision-support systems, and translate operational signals into clear recommendations and scalable, AI-first solutions. You should be comfortable moving from a high-level question to a rigorous analysis, a useful dashboard, an automated workflow, or a durable operating mechanism.

As OpenAI introduces new revenue-generating formats and partnerships, you’ll help the team understand where risks, capacity constraints, quality gaps, and opportunities are emerging. You’ll bring structure to ambiguity and ensure Ads Trust & Safety decisions are grounded in reliable data while balancing user safety, advertiser experience, and business growth.

In this role, you will:

- Own complex, high-impact Ads Trust & Safety data and operational problem areas from scoping through execution.

- Improve recurring reporting and dashboards by defining meaningful metrics, surfacing trends and gaps, and translating insights into operational decisions.

- Lead budget and capacity planning by connecting demand, review volumes, service levels, quality, and risk signals to staffing and operating plans.

- Conduct project-based analyses across advertiser risk, enforcement performance, review quality, product launches, and operational health; turn findings into clear recommendations and next steps.

- Partner closely with Data Science and Data Engineering teams to define goals, metric logic, data requirements, source-of-truth decisions, and QA data strategy.

- Design and maintain practical data-quality and measurement mechanisms, including sampling, validation, discrepancy investigation, quality dashboards, and feedback loops.

- Build and improve automations, AI-assisted workflows, and decision-support tools that reduce manual work and help Ads Trust & Safety and Ads Support scale.

- Drive operational readiness for new Ads and monetization launches, features, and markets by sizing impact, identifying risks early, and defining monitoring plans.

- Act as a senior cross-functional partner and subject-matter expert, communicating data-driven tradeoffs, priorities, and recommendations with strong judgment and credibility.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- 8+ years of experience in Trust & Safety, Business Integrity, technical operations, data analytics, or a closely related domain.

- Strong SQL skills and comfort working with unfamiliar, complex datasets, reconciling source-of-truth questions, and resolving data-quality issues.

- Experience building and owning dashboards, recurring reporting, monitoring, or operational measurement systems from scoping through adoption and maintenance.

- Experience using data for budget, capacity, or workforce planning, including translating demand, quality, and service-level signals into practical operating plans.

- Proven ability to independently own ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives and turn analysis into decisions, workflows, or scalable systems.

- In-depth experience leveraging AI models or agent-based tooling in operational workflows, or other lightweight technical development where useful.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analyses, data limitations, risk tradeoffs, and recommendations to diverse audiences.

- Strong judgment around quality, safeguards, responsible deployment, and the appropriate use of data in high-stakes operational decisions.

- Bonus: Familiarity with ads and advertiser ecosystems and the operational signals that shape review, enforcement, and support decisions.
